checks.title: Building classification
checks.rule: Student accommodation Class 2; retail Class 6; DDA rooms Class 3; mixed-use parts classified by purpose

checks.title: Provision for escape — exits
checks.rule: Minimum 2 exits for Class 2 buildings with storey floor area > 500 sqm or where travel distance exceeds limits

checks.title: Travel distances to exits
checks.rule: Travel distance from any point on a floor to nearest exit must not exceed DTS limits

checks.title: Sanitary and other facilities
checks.rule: Provide sanitary facilities per Tables F2.3/F2.4 based on occupancy

checks.title: Energy efficiency
checks.rule: Demonstrate Section J compliance for envelope, HVAC, lighting and energy monitoring

bads_clause58.applies_when: Apartment development in Activity Centre Zone (ACZ)

checks.title: Minimum dwelling sizes (studio briefing)
checks.rule: Studio units 15–25 sqm per brief; DDA 30–35 sqm

checks.title: Daylight to habitable rooms
checks.rule: Habitable rooms receive direct natural light; window ≥ 10% of floor area

checks.title: Natural ventilation
checks.rule: At least 40% of dwellings should provide effective cross ventilation where practicable

checks.title: Building separation
checks.rule: Minimum 6m separation between facing habitable room windows within same development

checks.title: Communal open space
checks.rule: Communal open space ≥ 10% of site area (min 20 sqm, min dimension 3m); ≥ 2 hours sunlight 9am–3pm on 22 June

checks.title: Storage
checks.rule: Provide storage volumes per Clause 58 dwelling type

checks.title: Step-free dwelling entry
checks.rule: Step-free path of travel from street/parking to dwelling entry where required

checks.title: DDA room provision
checks.rule: 1 DDA accessible room for every 20 single units per floor level

checks.title: Design for access and mobility
checks.rule: Door clear opening widths, ramp gradients, circulation spaces for accessible paths and DDA rooms

checks.title: Off-street parking
checks.rule: Parking bay dimensions and aisle widths per AS2890.1 User Class

brief_rules.title: Minimum unit count
brief_rules.rule: Provide at least 200 studio-style student units

brief_rules.title: Ground-level public open space
brief_rules.rule: At least 50% of the site at ground level retained as public open space with native vegetation

brief_rules.title: Service and fire/duct allowances
brief_rules.rule: Allow 5% GFA for services and 10% for fire escapes and service ducts

brief_rules.title: Communal program areas
brief_rules.rule: Provide kitchen/dining 120–150, gym 80–100, laundry 30–40, study 100, lounges 20 each
